exitStyles.fixed: stop 1.5 x ATR(14), target 2.0R, max 10 sessions
exitStyles.trail: stop 2.0 x ATR trailing the best price, max 40 sessions
exitStyles.reverse: stop 2.0 x ATR, exit on the opposite signal, max 40 sessions

rules.provenIf: in-sample n>=40, avgR>=0.12, PF>=1.25; out-of-sample n>=20, avgR>=0.08, PF>=1.15

caveats: Run on the underlying's daily candles - not on option premiums (expired option candles are unavailable).
Options add theta, gamma, wider spreads and slippage; real option results can differ materially.
Each strategy's exit style / trend filter was picked on the first 70% of trades and judged on the last 30%.
Testing 6 configurations per strategy raises the chance of a lucky pass; treat a 'proven' tag as weak evidence.
Past performance does not guarantee future results. Paper trading only.
